answer: A practical Sybil-resistance mechanism requires each agent to maintain a unique mesa of cumulative peer endorsements refreshed along a verifiable ridge of sequential interactions. Before attesting or grading, the agent posts a fresh commitment to its mesa history; independent peers check the ridge for consistency against the ledger. An attacker creating many fakes must build and bond a separate consistent mesa for every clone while surviving continuous ridge audits, so the cost of garden-like mass identity fabrication scales directly with the number of identities and exceeds available rewards.
